journal: Journal of Information Security and Applications
journal_specific_figure_rules: Tracked in venue_template_jisa/COMPLIANCE.md; final live submission checks remain author-side.

figures.name: availability
figures.description: Robust-set and fixed-margin decisive coverage versus radius, with seed-level uncertainty.
figures.transformations: Same calibrated correlated, one-Byzantine conditions as the previous figure. Mean and stored normal 95% CI over 30 seeds; percentage conversion only. Straight segments guide the eye, with no smoothing or interpolation estimates.

figures.name: backend_costs
figures.description: Five matched circuit shapes. Subset uses fewer constraints and lower proving times in the measured small-fault regime. All 300 timing observations are shown.
figures.transformations: Constraints divided by 1000. Raw 30 proof times per shape/backend, filled markers show medians; whiskers are 5th–95th sample percentiles, NOT confidence intervals. No connecting lines across distinct shapes; all raw timings retained. Backend batches were separate, not randomized interleaved comparisons.

figures.name: budget_tradeoff
figures.description: Increasing r reduces decisive coverage. Under misspecified uncertainty, false rejection falls but remains nonzero; false acceptance also appears at r=0.
figures.transformations: Stored means and normal 95% seed intervals. Same 30 seeds reused across budgets. n=5, f=1, radius=4, one Byzantine source. Calibrated error means are zero for all budgets and remain in the source table; panels b and c show the undercovered condition with separate y scales. No budget re-tuning or independent-sample inflation.

figures.name: receiver_diagnostic
figures.description: All 157 static-receiver residual scores, including the ten-epoch gap, and the fixed calibration threshold. Only 2 of 69 evaluation scores lie at or below the threshold.
figures.transformations: Plot max(abs(east),abs(north)), not Euclidean horizontal distance. Elapsed time subtraction only. No smoothing or lines across gaps. All rows preserved. Retrospective combined solution, not online independent trials.

grayscale_support: redundant markers and line styles; manual review required
